description: This Java source file defines the class AccountTransferHelper, which provides helper methods for constructing and performing account transfer operations in a testing context for the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to build transfer request payloads, execute transfers, and handle various scenarios such as invalid accounts, insufficient balances, and invalid dates. The class references external API endpoints, utilizes Gson for JSON serialization, and employs RestAssured for HTTP request specifications.

classes.name: AccountTransferHelper
classes.description: A helper class facilitating creation and execution of savings account transfer requests during integration testing, including methods for building transfer JSON payloads, performing transfers with different statuses, and simulating error conditions.

methods.name: AccountTransferHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing request and response specifications for making HTTP calls.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the JSON payload for an account transfer request based on provided account and client IDs, account types, and transfer amount.

methods.description: Sets the transfer date for the upcoming transfer.

methods.description: Performs a standard account transfer operation with fixed transfer date, returning server response indicating success or failure.

methods.description: Attempts a transfer involving non-existent account, expecting a 404 error.

methods.description: Attempts a transfer with insufficient account balance, expecting a 403 error.
